statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was directly mapped from the 'Depreciation and amortization' line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income...' section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. The supplementary tables contain detailed information on operating leases and parent company cash flows, but these do not provide additional breakdowns of the depreciation and amortization figure itself. Therefore, only the single, consolidated value from the primary statement is used for each period.
